text: if you have zero customers right now
the fastest way to get your first ten
is to go find people one at a time
not run ads not build a funnel just go talk to people
because at zero customers you have no idea what messaging works
so you manually go get ten people any way you can
dm them cold call them beg your friends whatever it takes
once you have ten paying customers you can start to see patterns
there are only four ways to get more customers
more leads more conversion more price or more repeat purchases
most people only ever pull the leads lever
but conversion is usually the cheapest lever to pull first
because you already paid for the leads you're getting
fixing your close rate is free money sitting on the table
so walk me through what a normal tuesday looks like at your gym
we get maybe forty people signed up for classes
but only like fifteen actually show up
okay so your problem isn't leads it's a no show problem
for gyms specifically the fix is a booking deposit
five or ten dollars refunded when they show up
that alone will usually cut your no show rate in half
discounting trains customers to wait for a discount
every time you discount you're teaching them your price is fake
raise the price and add more value instead
stop asking does that make sense
ask what questions do you have instead
one assumes they're following you the other invites the real objection
